owner_defects: D1: cannot open the map at all from the deployed build
D2: remove fog of war — geography visible from the start, markers hidden until discovered

D1_root_cause.symptom: M opens the inventory; swap_right walks one or two screens; then NOTHING the player presses reaches the game ever again. The map is four screens along the ring, so it is unreachable — and the menu is also unclosable.
D1_root_cause.mechanism: It is not a navigation bug at all. In `mode: 'play'` the FIXED LOOP STOPS. Instrumented at HEAD: `uiPausedFrames` climbs 19 -> 44 -> 59 and then freezes at 59 for the rest of the run, while `window` still receives every keydown. `Engine._step()`'s paused branch is what latches input while a screen is open, so once the loop stops ticking, `sim.uiDriver` is never called again and no key can reach `UISystem.step`.
D1_root_cause.evidence: tools/map/explore-W1-MAP-DEFECTS.mjs (diagnosis, throwaway) — DOM keydown logged for every press after the freeze, with no matching `driver`/`step` entry. tools/map/player-route.mjs is the keeper: real boot, real key presses, no harness driving.
D1_root_cause.why_the_existing_probe_says_otherwise: tools/ui/critic-w1-21-r2-doors-at-head.mjs reaches all six screens — from `loadState('ui-journal')` in `play-instrumented` mode, where the harness advances the clock by hand. It never runs the rAF loop, so it cannot see this.
D1_root_cause.next: identify what stops the rAF loop (diag2 instruments loop.running / rafTicks / an independent rAF chain / throws inside the tick)
